summary: Tested the new 'reschedule appointment' feature (backend PATCH /api/appointments/{id}/reschedule and frontend RescheduleModal in Meus Agendamentos). All 9 pytest cases pass covering happy-path, 404 (other user), 400 (cancelled/closed day Sun+Mon/invalid time/past date), and 409 (slot taken by another user + admin-blocked slot) plus barber-preserved check. Frontend end-to-end flow verified in browser: Reagendar button visible on confirmed card, modal opens with day/slot grids, current slot disabled, success toast shown, card updates to new date/time, availability old->available / new->booked. reminder_sent correctly reset to False after reschedule.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py reschedule_appointment: ObjectId(apt_id) is called without a try/except — a malformed id in the URL will raise bson.errors.InvalidId and surface as 500 instead of 404. Wrap in try/except and return 404.
Availability for 'any' barber inside the past branch always marks 'past' as the status; if slot is also booked by all barbers it's still just 'past'. Minor, cosmetic only.
No index on appointments.(barber_id, date, time) — reschedule clash check and availability queries will scan as data grows. Consider a compound index.

RescheduleModal: 'days' list only shows 21 calendar days starting today filtered to Tue-Sat; if the current appointment is >21 days out the UI cannot select the current day — acceptable but worth documenting.
test_credentials: Admin filipe.capoli@gmail.com / Studio01Admin; test clients auto-registered with ui_resched_* and test_reschedule_* prefixes (cancelled at end of tests).
seed_data_creation: Appointments created during tests are all cancelled in test teardown. Admin block created in test_reject_admin_blocked_slot_409 is toggled off at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reschedule feature fully working end-to-end. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_reschedule.py (9 tests, all pass in ~4.5s). Frontend verified via Playwright: data-testids reschedule-appointment-btn, reschedule-modal, reschedule-day-btn, reschedule-slot-btn, reschedule-confirm-btn, reschedule-close-btn all working. Previous iterations (1 & 2) covered auth/booking/admin/barber CRUD/WhatsApp/cron — still green.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the reschedule feature.
